Also noted: Sunbelt Q3 (fiscal, prior period) consolidated revenue +2.7% to $2.6B, equipment rental revenue +2.6% to $2.4B, FY2026 rental revenue growth guided 2-3% at that time; EquipmentShare (new rental IPO peer) posted Q1 total revenue $989M (+38% y/y), rental revenue $764M (+37%), adjusted core EBITDA $399M (+39%). Mega-project activity (manufacturing, LNG, renewables, data centers) cited as offsetting softer local commercial demand sector-wide.
